harness_contract.learning_evaluation_protocol: For persistent-learning scenarios, pre-register objective-specific metrics and tolerances, freeze baseline/candidate/data/protocol digests, repeat at least three seeded runs, include held-out and unseen controls, verify persistence across restart, and test unrelated-task regression. Do not accept training-set-only gains or post-hoc thresholds.
